_comment: Per-stage classification declarations, consumed by scripts/workflow_fingerprint.py's load_implementation_stage_classification()/load_plan_stage_classification() (WF4a-i, D-Fingerprint-Generalization). Non-immutable registry metadata -- lives under docs/ai-workflow/registry/, already a PLAN_STAGE_EXCLUDED_PREFIXES entry, EXCEPT this file's own concrete implementation_stage.protected_paths entry below, so editing this file's plan_stage key DOES change plan-stage review_content_id (bound by plan_approval), while editing its implementation_stage key does NOT change plan-stage review_content_id but DOES change implementation-stage review_content_id (bound by technical_approval, via this file's own self-referential protected-path entry, OPUS-R25-006/OPUS-R26-004). 'protected' at the implementation stage means the content technical_approval binds to (source, test, build, migration, workflow-command files, per D-Commit-Provenance); 'excluded' means plan-stage-governed design content or runtime-mutable state that is never itself an implementation deliverable. Any path named in neither set fails closed (UnclassifiedPathError), same discipline as the plan-stage classifier. 'protected' at the plan stage means the exact design documents a plan-stage reviewer is approving; 'excluded' means everything else this work item's own commits are known to touch. Any path named in neither set fails closed at the plan stage too.

excluded_paths..github/workflows/ci.yml: operational CI wiring for the prototype's test suite -- the design decision it implements (stdlib-only Python, tested every PR) is recorded in the protected docs/TECHNICAL_DECISIONS.md; the workflow file itself also carries unrelated Android build/lint/test steps that must not stale this milestone's approval
excluded_paths.AGENTS.md: product/repository content outside this process work item's declared scope -- concurrent work items (product milestones, functional-finding fixes, other tooling changes) may write here; fail-closed is preserved for any path outside this named set (resolves OPUS-R18-004)

Moved here from PLAN_STAGE_PROTECTED (resolves OPUS-R14-001/-009): pre-declaring it protected while unwritten made D-States' 'checkpoints never touch protected documents' invariance false the moment WF4a-iv actually created it, since that creation is itself a checkpoint touching a protected path. Excluding it (like the other operator-facing docs above) means WF4a-iv can write it without staling the plan approval, and a plan-stage bundle never needs to tombstone a not-yet-written protected path in the first place
